mapper.sql:
WITH visible AS ( SELECT r.location_id,r.id,'REPAIR_REQUEST' resource_type,r.request_no business_no,r.equipment_name,r.status,r.created_at, CASE WHEN r.status='NEEDS_SUPPLEMENT' THEN 'needsSupplement' ELSE 'pendingReview' END stage, r.status category FROM repair_request r JOIN campus_location l ON l.id=r.location_id JOIN campus_floor f ON f.id=l.floor_id WHERE r.location_mode='STRUCTURED' AND r.status IN ('PENDING_REVIEW','NEEDS_SUPPLEMENT')
AND r.reporter_id=#{scope.userId} AND 1=0
UNION ALL SELECT o.location_id,o.id,'WORK_ORDER' resource_type,o.work_order_no business_no,r.equipment_name,o.status,o.created_at, CASE o.status WHEN 'PENDING_ACCEPT' THEN 'pendingAccept' WHEN 'REASSIGN_PENDING' THEN 'reassignPending' WHEN 'PENDING_ACCEPTANCE' THEN 'pendingAcceptance' ELSE CASE WHEN o.current_round>1 THEN 'rework' ELSE 'inProgress' END END stage, CASE WHEN o.status='PENDING_ACCEPTANCE' THEN 'PENDING_ACCEPTANCE' ELSE 'FAULT_PROCESSING' END category FROM work_order o JOIN repair_request r ON r.id=o.request_id JOIN campus_location l ON l.id=o.location_id JOIN campus_floor f ON f.id=l.floor_id WHERE o.location_mode='STRUCTURED' AND o.status IN ('PENDING_ACCEPT','REASSIGN_PENDING','IN_PROGRESS','PENDING_ACCEPTANCE')
AND o.reporter_id=#{scope.userId}
AND ((o.status='PENDING_ACCEPT' AND o.assigned_technician_id=#{scope.userId}) OR (o.status IN ('IN_PROGRESS','PENDING_ACCEPTANCE') AND o.accepted_technician_id=#{scope.userId}))
AND 1=0
)
mapper.select: SELECT location_id,SUM(stage='pendingAccept') pending_accept,SUM(stage='reassignPending') reassign_pending, SUM(stage='inProgress') in_progress,SUM(stage='rework') rework,SUM(stage='pendingAcceptance') pending_acceptance, SUM(stage='needsSupplement') needs_supplement,SUM(stage='pendingReview') pending_review FROM visible GROUP BY location_id ORDER BY location_id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM visible WHERE category=#{category}
